$comment: What `kit dotfiles` carries between machines. portable: paths kept in your private dotfiles folder and linked back onto each machine, stored there under their base name; exclude names entries inside a folder that stay on the machine (and go into the folder's .gitignore). neverSync: paths that must never be in the folder; `kit dotfiles check` fails when one is.

portable.what: Model, enabled plugins, marketplaces, permissions, output style
Imported by CLAUDE.md where it says @RTK.md

portable.excludeWhy: the Claude desktop app's managed copy of Anthropic's skills; each machine's app rebuilds it

portable.what: agent-kit's naming guard list, for its contributors

neverSync.why: Machine and account ids, per-project history and user-scope MCP entries
Installed plugins and marketplace clones; each machine installs its own
Session transcripts and memory, keyed to this machine's paths
